networks.name: agen_grosir
networks.description: Agen Grosir Mitra: daftar harga sembako grosir, hitung restock dan hari antar, pesan bayar di tempat. Wholesale restock agent that warung agents can call across sites.
sample_queries: Berapa harga minyak goreng dan gula per dus/bal?
Hitung 3 dus minyak goreng 2 L dan 2 bal gula. Kapan diantar?
Pesan 2 dus mi goreng dan 2 dus air mineral untuk Warung Bu Sri, WA 081234567890, Jl. Margasari No. 5, Karawang Timur.
Bisa bayar pakai kartu kredit atau dicicil?

peer_policy.note: Calls no other sites. Other agent sites may run this network; the bridge shares the price list and quote with any site, and the restock order (in Grosir Mitra's own window) only with Buku Bon Agentik.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.
